title: "BeSD Country Report: `r params$country`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    highlight: tango
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    self_contained: true
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
    latex_engine: xelatex
params:
  country:           "Unknown"
  besd_sum:          NULL
  demo_sum:          NULL
  domain_filter:     "all"
  compare_countries: NULL
  comparison_item:   NULL
  include_profile:   TRUE
  include_demos:     FALSE
  breakdown_sum:     NULL
  bk_item:           NULL
  bk_dem_vars:       NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10)
library(rbesd)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

cty               <- params$country
besd_sum          <- params$besd_sum
demo_sum          <- params$demo_sum
domain_filter     <- params$domain_filter
compare_countries <- params$compare_countries
comparison_item   <- params$comparison_item
include_profile   <- isTRUE(params$include_profile)
include_demos     <- isTRUE(params$include_demos)

dd_cty <- besd_sum |> dplyr::filter(country == cty)
```

`r if (knitr::is_latex_output()) '\\newpage'`

This report summarises BeSD (Behavioural and Social Drivers of vaccination)
survey findings for **`r params$country`**.

---

```{r profile_sections, results='asis', fig.width=10}
if (include_profile) {
  cat("## Sample Composition\n\n")
}
```

```{r demo_table, results='asis'}
if (include_profile) {
  if (!is.null(demo_sum) && nrow(demo_sum) > 0) {
    tbl <- demo_sum |>
      dplyr::filter(as.character(country) == cty) |>
      dplyr::arrange(item_id, response) |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        Variable = as.character(question_short),
        Category = as.character(response),
        N        = n,
        `%`      = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(Variable = ifelse(duplicated(Variable), "", Variable))
    if (nrow(tbl) > 0) {
      cat(knitr::kable(tbl, align = c("l", "l", "r", "r"),
                       format = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html",
                       booktabs = TRUE), sep = "\n")
    } else {
      cat("No demographic data available for", cty)
    }
  } else {
    cat("No demographic data available.")
  }
}
```

```{r bar_plot_header, results='asis'}
if (include_profile) {
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) cat("\\newpage\n\n")
  cat("## BeSD Response Profile\n\n")
}
```

```{r bar_plot, results='asis'}
if (include_profile) {
  no_title <- patchwork::plot_annotation(title = "")

  if (nrow(dd_cty) == 0) {
    cat("No response data available for", cty)
  } else if (domain_filter == "all") {
    domain_order  <- c("thinking and feeling", "social processes", "practical issues")
    domain_labels <- c(
      "thinking and feeling" = "Thinking & Feeling",
      "social processes"     = "Social Processes",
      "practical issues"     = "Practical Issues"
    )
    for (dom in domain_order) {
      dd_dom <- dd_cty |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(domain) & domain == dom)
      if (nrow(dd_dom) == 0) next
      cat("\n\n###", domain_labels[[dom]], "\n\n")
      plots <- rbesd::plot_besd_bars(dd_dom)
      for (p in plots) print(p + no_title)
    }
  } else {
    dd_dom <- dd_cty |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(domain) & domain == domain_filter)
    if (nrow(dd_dom) > 0) {
      plots <- rbesd::plot_besd_bars(dd_dom)
      for (p in plots) print(p + no_title)
    } else {
      cat("No data for selected domain.")
    }
  }
}
```

```{r radar_header, results='asis'}
if (include_profile) {
  cat("\n\n---\n\n## Radar Profile\n\n")
}
```

```{r radar_plot, fig.height=6}
if (include_profile) {
  ctys_for_radar <- unique(c(cty, compare_countries))
  ctys_for_radar <- ctys_for_radar[
    ctys_for_radar %in% unique(as.character(besd_sum$country))
  ]

  dd_radar   <- besd_sum |> dplyr::filter(country %in% ctys_for_radar)
  tb_check   <- rbesd::besd_topbox(dd_radar)

  if (nrow(tb_check) >= 3) {
    rbesd::plot_besd_spider(
      dd_radar,
      focal_country = cty,
      compare       = if (length(ctys_for_radar) > 1) ctys_for_radar else "all",
      overlay       = length(ctys_for_radar) > 1
    )
  } else {
    cat("Insufficient data to draw radar chart.")
  }
}
```

```{r demos_header, results='asis'}
}
```

```{r demographic_breakdowns, results='asis', fig.width=10}
if (include_demos &&
    !is.null(params$breakdown_sum) && nrow(params$breakdown_sum) > 0 &&
    !is.null(params$bk_item) && !is.null(params$bk_dem_vars) &&
    length(params$bk_dem_vars) > 0) {

  bk_cty  <- params$country
  bk_iid  <- as.character(params$bk_item)
  bk_vars <- params$bk_dem_vars

  for (var in bk_vars) {
    dd_bk <- params$breakdown_sum |>
      dplyr::filter(
        as.character(.data$country)      == bk_cty,
        as.character(.data$item_id)      == bk_iid,
        as.character(.data$subgroup_var) == var
      )
    if (nrow(dd_bk) == 0) next

    # Response ordering: respect factor levels from besd_sum if present
    ref_rows <- besd_sum |>
      dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$country) == bk_cty,
                    as.character(.data$item_id)  == bk_iid)
    if ("response_key" %in% names(ref_rows) && is.factor(ref_rows$response_key)) {
      levs       <- levels(droplevels(ref_rows$response_key))
      resp_order <- unique(sub(".*___", "", levs))
      resp_order <- resp_order[resp_order %in% as.character(dd_bk$response)]
    } else {
      resp_order <- as.character(unique(dd_bk$response))
    }

    n_resp    <- length(resp_order)
    resp_cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#CC278D", "#926F97", "#4F8D9A"))(n_resp)

    var_label <- unique(as.character(dd_bk$subgroup_label))
    var_label <- if (length(var_label) > 0 && !is.na(var_label[1]) && nzchar(var_label[1]))
      var_label[1] else var

    # Subgroup level ordering: by % of the most positive response
    top_resp  <- resp_order[n_resp]
    grp_order <- dd_bk |>
      dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$response) == top_resp) |>
      dplyr::arrange(.data$pct) |>
      dplyr::pull(.data$subgroup_level) |>
      as.character()
    if (!length(grp_order))
      grp_order <- sort(unique(as.character(dd_bk$subgroup_level)))

    dd_bk <- dd_bk |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        response      = factor(as.character(.data$response), levels = resp_order),
        subgroup_level = factor(as.character(.data$subgroup_level), levels = grp_order)
      )

    cat("\n\n###", var_label, "\n\n")

    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(dd_bk,
           ggplot2::aes(x = .data$pct, y = .data$subgroup_level,
                        fill = .data$response)) +
      ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.7) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
        values = stats::setNames(resp_cols, resp_order),
        name   = ""
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "", y = "") +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
      ggplot2::theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9)
      )
    print(p)
  }
} else if (include_demos) {
  cat("No demographic breakdown data available for this selection.\n")
}
```
